items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: George, and, and, and, and Jim Williams, and Baptiste, there was three real top-notch men in a Joan and Roe show band.

ctx.x: In Philadelphia. Philadelphia, yeah. That's where I saw him. A couple of times, never got to talk to him very much.

George, and, and, and, and Jim Williams, and Baptiste, there was three real top-notch men in a Joan and Roe show band. Now, that, there was a band, you, you get the music, see, Joan and Roe, she'd pass out the music, yeah. Get new numbers, pass, yeah. Joan and Roe, she'd start with that band. George Cross and Lake, look at that music, Mary, what? Played like, it's like you played blues or anything else. And, and, and, and, and, and James Williams, not, and Baptiste, Baptiste, the little trombone. Baptiste,…
